description: Numeric boundary — within 24 hours vs next business day

source_documents.sales_conversation: Customer: 'How fast do you respond to tickets?' Sales: 'Within 24 hours.'
source_documents.contract_text: Section 9.2 Response Time: Vendor shall respond within one business day.

contract_terms.evidence: Vendor shall respond within one business day.

alignments.reasoning: 24 hours (calendar) vs one business day (typically 8 hours, but excludes weekends). Not equal for Friday-Saturday tickets. Requires interpretation.
